notes: The artifact is a complete execution contract: compact codes require matching activation transforms and higher-precision sensitive tensors.
Signs must not simply replace the original weights; a pinned vendor-compatible reference backend must reproduce the vendor path first.
The published 27B card warns about missing transform support at some upstream revisions; pin a working commit and run transform fixtures (S21, S24).
Architecture string must be confirmed from the published GGUF's general.architecture before promotion from 'specified'.
PQ2_0 and PTQ1_0 formats are certified independently (FR-30); each needs its own kernel evidence.
No mandatory draft: a compact model's draft can be a large fraction of available 8GB RAM.
